components: Inherit official prebuilt WLA-DX workflow, MIT notice and separate Darkrose font provenance/limits from the shared manifest; no independently reproduced build or binary redistribution
reporting: Audited bodies write no SB/SC; all report through common quit (quit_ok, quit_check_asserts, quit_failure_string, quit_inline). Require the first packet and B/C/D/E/H/L signature. All five are ROM-only (header 0147 = 00) and DMG-verified in their source headers.
